careers.title: Java Developer
responsibilities: Develop high-quality, scalable backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
Design and implement RESTful APIs to integrate with frontend applications.
Optimize application performance and ensure system reliability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and ship new features.
requirements: 3+ years of professional experience in Java development.
Strong knowledge of Spring Framework / Spring Boot.
Understanding of microservices architecture and cloud platforms.

careers.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
responsibilities: Develop and execute comprehensive digital marketing strategies.
Manage SEO/SEM, email marketing, and social media campaigns.
Analyze web traffic and build reports on marketing performance metrics.
Identify trends and insights to optimize spend and performance.
requirements: Proven experience in digital marketing or a similar role.
Familiarity with Google Analytics, Ads, and social media tools.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Creativity in identifying target audiences and devising digital campaigns.

careers.title: Business Analyst
responsibilities: Analyze business processes and identify areas for improvement.
Gather and document business requirements from stakeholders.
Translate business needs into technical specifications for developers.
Asssist in project management and ensure deadlines are met.
requirements: Experience in business analysis or project management.
Ability to communicate complex information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Proficiency in documentation and reporting tools.
